name: Honda Manufacturing of Alabama (HMA) - Lincoln AL

fieldNotes.location: HMA confirmed via satellite + roster address 1800 Honda Drive. Roster point landed near plant center; the auto+engine campus is the massive multi-building complex centered ~33.6155,-86.1440, with an on-site vehicle test track to the north, SW of Lincoln AL.
fieldNotes.scale_of_facility: HMA is ~4.9 million sq ft on a 1,350-acre property in Talladega County (web research) - the first Honda facility with engine and vehicle assembly in the same complex. Builds Odyssey, Pilot, Passport, Ridgeline plus V6 engines.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Major OEM auto+engine plant on a fully secured private campus - public Street View reaches only wooded approach roads, no gates. A checkpoint structure with vehicle lanes is visible at the SW entrance off Honda Drive. Treated true (medium confidence on lane geometry).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Guarded entry standard for a high-security plant of this scale; a small checkpoint structure is visible at the SW entrance. Listed uncertain on exact form.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yards on multiple building faces - many dozens to hundreds of trailers in rows; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multiple long dock banks with trailers backed in on several building faces; 50+ band, overhead estimate ~120.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur identified entering the property; HMA runs truck-based logistics. Set false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of vehicle assembly, engine plant, support and logistics buildings, plus an on-site vehicle test track.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity on physically separate building faces supports separate ship/receive.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box captures the developed plant core plus lots (~900 ac); the full Honda-owned property is ~1,350 ac including test track and wooded buffer.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural / edge-of-town setting SW of Lincoln AL amid woods and farmland.
